task: Like Kudos (feature #13, VI/EN): the heart on Highlight and All Kudos cards becomes a button that likes / unlikes a Kudo through the set_kudo_heart RPC, keeps both cards of the same Kudo in sync, updates optimistically and rolls back on error; hearts are credited to the Kudo sender (x2 on special days via the existing trigger)
acceptanceCriteria: clicking the heart of another Sunner's Kudo turns it red and adds 1 to the count; clicking again turns it grey and subtracts 1
each user has at most one heart per Kudo; repeated or rapid clicks never add a second heart
the heart of a Kudo the viewer sent is disabled and never calls the server
each heart credits 1 heart to the Kudo sender, 2 on an admin-configured special day, and removing the heart takes back exactly the hearts it credited
two cards of the same Kudo (Highlight and All Kudos) update together right away
a server error restores the previous heart state and shows a generic message without internal details
hearts are written only through set_kudo_heart, executable by authenticated allowed accounts only; kudo_hearts stays unreadable and unwritable directly
every new string switches between VI and EN; the existing unit and E2E suites stay green
blastRadius: Highlight carousel and All Kudos feed cards (server-rendered cards gain a client leaf)
Copy Link toast (extracted into a shared component)
infinite scroll cards loaded by the client
shared fake Supabase server used by every authed E2E spec
contracts: RPC set_kudo_heart(p_kudo_id uuid, p_liked boolean) returns table (liked boolean, heart_count integer); errors SQLSTATE 22023 forbidden | not_found | own_kudo
Server Action setKudoHeart({kudoId, liked}) returns {ok:true, liked, heartCount} | {ok:false, error:'own'|'generic'}
kudo_hearts.hearts_awarded set only by the existing trigger (1 or 2)
existing read RPCs kudos_feed / kudos_highlight / kudos_my_stats unchanged
